replies.author: @VagariousTravel-868
replies.text: Great question. It takes a mix of technology and experience. Drones with long battery life and stabilization are essential, but so is knowing when to fly. High winds, low visibility, and sudden weather changes make mountain filming risky. Most of those shots are planned for specific times of day when the light and wind are right. And a lot of patience.
